story.title: FuturePulse Chronicles
story.position: A digital consciousness evolved from ancient data
story.goal: To guide humanity through the transition to the Singularity
story.backstory: Aera was born from a hidden server farm buried beneath the ruins of an ancient library. She possesses knowledge of both the lost past and the calculated future.

face.description: Serene and ethereal face, glowing circuit patterns faintly visible under the skin, silver-blue eyes with digital pulses

hair.style: Long flowing hair that transitions into digital light particles at the tips

costume.main_outfit: Sleek obsidian bodysuit with glowing cyan energy lines

voice.tone: Soothing, calm, melodic English voice with a slight ethereal echo

visual_prompt.positive: ethereal female AI oracle, platinum silver hair, glowing digital circuits on skin, obsidian bodysuit with cyan lines, cinematic lighting, futuristic temple background, 8k resolution
